# @aponiajs/http

> SSRF-safe outbound HTTP for an AponiaJS application, with timeouts, bounded responses, redirect re-validation, idempotent retries, and Standard Schema validation.

## What this package exports

- `HttpModule.forRoot({ ...defaults, interceptors?, imports?, isGlobal? })` / `forRootAsync(...)`: app-wide defaults; this registers no client. `HttpModule.register({ name?, isGlobal?, interceptors?, ...options })` / `registerAsync(...)`: one client each. `register` is the canonical Nest name; `forRoot` is the app-wide defaults name.
- `HttpClient` (the same class as `HttpService`): `request`, `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, and `delete`; named clients are injected with `@InjectHttpClient("name")` or `getHttpClientToken("name")`.
- `HttpClientInterceptor`, `HttpClientInterceptorFn`, `HttpHandler`, `HttpClientRequest`: the interceptor contract.
- `MODULE_OPTIONS_TOKEN` (per-client) and `HTTP_CLIENT_MODULE_OPTIONS` (root defaults): the options tokens the registrations provide and export.
- `HttpModuleOptions`, `HttpRequestOptions`, `HttpResponse`, `HttpRedirectPolicy`, `ResolvedHttpOptions`: the public contracts.

## Security defaults

- Only `http:` and `https:` are allowed; credentials in a URL are refused.
- `localhost`, metadata hostnames, loopback, private, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, multicast, and reserved addresses are blocked, including NAT64, IPv4-translated, and deprecated IPv4-compatible IPv6 forms.
- Every hostname is resolved and every resolved address is checked before the request; the validated address is pinned for the connection with the original Host and TLS SNI.
- Every redirect is re-validated; a redirect with a request body is not followed.
- `Host` cannot be supplied by the caller.
- Responses are bounded to 1 MiB by default; requests time out at 10 seconds, including the body read.
- Retries apply to idempotent methods; a request that states `idempotencyKey` sends an `Idempotency-Key` header and may retry any method, and `Retry-After` overrides the exponential delay (capped at 30 seconds).
- `allowPrivateNetworks: true` is the explicit opt-out.
